web-welcome-page.header: Welcome page of the Web application

blocks.content: The signpost of the Web application. It opens when you switch to the Web application in the header and its cards show what you find in this part of the administration.

cards.title: Website texts
cards.text: Editing the texts and content of the public pages of the website - translations, page titles, FAQ, jobs, references and the knowledge base.

cards.title: Inquiries
cards.text: Inquiries visitors sent through the contact form of the website.

cards.title: Job applicants
cards.text: Job applications sent from the form of a job position.

cards.title: Web logs
cards.text: History of all actions taken in the Web application.

blocks.content: Click a card to open the page. A card of a page you have no permission for is not shown. The same pages are also in the left menu.
The page requires the permission to show the welcome page of the web section (web-welcome-page-view). You get into the Web application only with the permission of the Web tab (view-web).

The website dashboard is an overview of the operation of the public website: numbers of inquiries and applicants, activity in the log, quick links and the state of the website. With the permission you also switch the website into maintenance mode from here.

sections.heading: 01. Header and state of the website

blocks.content: The header shows the title Website overview, the time of the last update and the Refresh button. Next to it is the state of the public website (Online, Online · problem, Offline · maintenance, Unavailable) and, for accounts with the permission to switch the website to maintenance mode (web-set-maintenance-mode), the button Switch application off / Switch application on. Switching off and on is described in the chapter Applications.
A switched-off website is not seen by any visitor - the maintenance page with contacts is shown instead. The contact form and job applications do not work during maintenance.

cards.title: Inquiries
cards.text: The number of inquiries on the Inquiries page.

cards.title: Applicants
cards.text: The number of job applications on the Job applicants page.

cards.title: Log entries
cards.text: The number of entries in the web log.

blocks.content: Choose the main tile by clicking its name; the other numbers are in the overview by module and in the coloured distribution bar. It works the same as the system dashboard. You see numbers only for pages you have permission for.

items: The cards Website texts, Inquiries, Job applicants and Web logs open their page.
Recent activity shows the last eight entries of the web log (who created, edited, deleted or exported what). View all opens Web logs.
Recent events breakdown shows the share of action types among these entries.

blocks.content: On this page you process the inquiries visitors sent through the contact form of the website. Every inquiry has a topic, a contact, a description, a processing status and a priority, and manually added ones also attachments. Here you also edit the text of the confirmation e-mail the customer receives after sending an inquiry.
New inquiries are also shown in the calendar in the panel Waiting for you. If nobody goes through them regularly, the customer waits - decide who is in charge of them.

steps.label: Form on the website
steps.text: On the Contact page the visitor chooses a topic, fills in the contact e-mail, phone and a description of the request and confirms the consent to the processing of personal data. The form is protected against robots and flooding.

steps.label: Saving
steps.text: The inquiry is saved with the status New and appears in the table.

steps.label: Confirmation to the customer
steps.text: The customer automatically receives a confirmation e-mail in the language they used on the website (chapter 06).

steps.label: Processing
steps.text: You take the inquiry over, change its status and write internal notes.

blocks.highlight: When the website is switched off
blocks.content: In maintenance mode the form accepts no inquiries.

cards.title: ID
cards.text: The number of the inquiry.

cards.title: Topic
cards.text: The subject of the inquiry - New project / inquiry, Existing project support, Collaboration / careers, Other, or a custom text.

cards.title: Email
cards.text: The contact e-mail of the customer.

cards.title: Status
cards.text: New, In progress, Done, Cancelled.

cards.title: Priority
cards.text: Low, Neutral, High.

cards.title: Created
cards.text: When the inquiry arrived.

blocks.content: Filter by ID, topic, e-mail, status and priority. The details of an inquiry (Details icon) show all data including the phone, the full description, the internal note, attachments (View / Download) and the date of the last change.

steps.label: Open the inquiry
steps.text: Read the full description and the attachments with the Details icon.

steps.label: Edit
steps.text: The edit icon (Edit) opens the form.

steps.label: Processing status
steps.text: Set In progress once you take the inquiry over; Done when handled; Cancelled when it will not go ahead.

steps.label: Priority
steps.text: Mark the importance - it helps with sorting and filtering.

steps.label: Internal note
steps.text: A note for colleagues (the customer does not see it) - for example who was talked to and what was agreed.

steps.label: Confirm
steps.text: The changes are saved and written to the web log.

blocks.content: Nothing is sent to the customer when the status changes. Answer them from your own e-mail to the address of the inquiry.

An inquiry that came another way (phone, a meeting) is added with Add record in the Actions menu. Fill in Topic / Subject (3-255 characters), Contact e-mail, Phone, Processing status, Priority, Request description (required), Internal note, and you can attach files (at most 10 files, each up to 20 MB, up to 50 MB in total).
A manually added inquiry also sends the confirmation e-mail to the entered address. Enter only the real address of the customer.

Add many inquiries at once (for example a transfer from another system) with Import data in the Actions menu. The procedure - template, file check, confirmation - is in the introductory chapter. Imported inquiries send no confirmation e-mail.
In the Actions menu choose Edit confirmation e-mail. An editor opens with the text the customer receives after sending an inquiry:

cards.title: E-mail subject
cards.text: Shown in the mailbox; the system adds “ – topic of the inquiry” to it.

cards.title: E-mail heading and Greeting
cards.text: For example “Your inquiry has been received” and “Hello,”.

cards.title: Intro message
cards.text: The main message - thanks and what happens next.

cards.title: Summary
cards.text: The heading of the section and the labels of the table in which the customer sees their topic, e-mail, phone, description, attachments and date received.

cards.title: Closing message
cards.text: For example “If you have any questions, feel free to contact us.”

items: The text is filled in separately for every language of the website. An empty field uses the Czech text, and when that is empty too, the default English wording. Empty fields are therefore marked orange and every language shows its number of empty fields.
The Live preview at the bottom shows how the e-mail looks; the summary in the preview is filled with sample data.
Save stores the template, Cancel closes the editor without saving.

blocks.content: Editing the template requires the permission to edit inquiries (web-user-requests-update).

items: Delete moves an inquiry to the trash; in the trash you restore it or delete it permanently (with its attachments).
Inquiries can also be deleted in bulk - select them with the checkboxes and choose Delete selected in the bar.
The export of inquiries (Actions → export data) contains personal data - handle it with care.
Old inquiries are deleted automatically according to the retention in Settings → Data retention (row Web inquiries).

cards.text: web-user-requests-view

cards.title: Manual adding and import
cards.text: web-user-requests-create

cards.title: Editing an inquiry and the confirmation e-mail
cards.text: web-user-requests-update

blocks.content: The web log is the history of all actions in the Web application: who created, edited or deleted an inquiry or an applicant, who changed the website texts and translations, who exported what, when the website was switched off or on and which errors occurred.
Entries cannot be edited or deleted. Old entries are deleted by the nightly clean-up according to the retention of audit logs (Settings → Data retention).

sections.heading: 01. What you find in the log

cards.title: Action
cards.text: Created, Updated, Soft deleted, Permanently deleted, Restored, Trash emptied, Bulk deleted, Exported, Error, Maintenance mode changed, Unauthorized maintenance toggle attempt.

cards.title: Module
cards.text: Inquiries, Job applications, Website translations, Web (general).

cards.title: Other columns
cards.text: Time, User, Event description and IP address.

blocks.content: An error at an inquiry often means the confirmation e-mail to the customer could not be sent - the description says why. If errors repeat, contact technical support.

Filters, entry details with technical data, export and charts work the same as in System logs - see that chapter and the introductory chapter. Typical questions: who changed the status of an inquiry (module Inquiries, action Updated), who switched the website off (action Maintenance mode changed).
The log contains e-mails and IP addresses - protect exports and delete them after use.
The permission to show the log history of the web section (web-view-web-logs).

edit-website.header: Texts and content of the website

blocks.content: The Website texts page manages all content of the public website: the texts of all pages in all languages, the languages of the website, the page titles in the browser, frequently asked questions (FAQ), job positions, references and the public knowledge base. Each part is a separate tab at the top.
Changes show on the website right after saving. With a read-only permission (web-edit-website-view) the page is read-only; an account with web-edit-website-update may save.

cards.title: Translations
cards.text: All texts of the website (headings, paragraphs, buttons, form labels) and the languages of the website.

cards.title: Page titles
cards.text: The text in the browser tab and in search results for every page of the website.

cards.title: FAQ
cards.text: Frequently asked questions divided into categories.

cards.title: Jobs
cards.text: Job offers on the Careers page.

cards.title: References
cards.text: Completed projects.

cards.title: Knowledge base
cards.text: The public help page (/knowledge-base).

blocks.content: A tab with unsaved changes is marked. Every tab is saved separately with its own button.

At the top of the Translations tab is the row of the website languages with flags. Click a language to show its texts. Czech is the default language - it is the template of all texts and cannot be switched off or deleted.

steps.label: Add language
steps.text: Add language opens the form.

steps.label: Language icon
steps.text: A flag image PNG or JPG up to 512 KB.

steps.label: Language code
steps.text: 2-5 lower-case letters, for example sk, de, fr. Every code only once.

steps.label: Language name
steps.text: For example “Slovenčina”.

steps.label: Language active
steps.text: Ticked = the language is offered to visitors in the language switch. Keep a new language inactive until its texts are translated.

items: The icon at a language deactivates or activates it - visitors do not see an inactive language, its texts stay.
The bin icon deletes the language from the list (after a confirmation). The file with its texts stays on the server.
The upload icon uploads the texts of the language from a JSON file (see chapter 04).

steps.label: Choose the language
steps.text: Click the language in the row of languages.

steps.label: Find the text
steps.text: The table has the columns Key (JSON path) - where the text is used on the website, for example navigation.home - and Value in the language. The field Search key or text… searches keys and texts.

steps.label: Edit
steps.text: Rewrite the text in the Value field. The field grows with the text.

steps.label: Save changes
steps.text: Save changes stores the texts of the current language. A dot on the button warns of unsaved changes.

cards.title: keys / filled / missing
cards.text: Statistics of the language: how many texts the website has, how many are filled and how many are missing.

cards.title: Missing translations
cards.text: A text missing in the language has an exclamation mark. The button “N missing” (or a click on the missing statistic) shows only the missing texts.

cards.title: What the visitor sees
cards.text: Instead of a missing text the website shows “Cannot load text”. So fill in all texts before activating a language.

blocks.content: Do not change the key - the website looks the text up by it. Change only the value. Unsaved changes are lost when you switch the language or leave the page without saving.

items: Download JSON downloads all texts of the current language into a file - useful as a backup or for a translator.
Upload JSON uploads a file with the same structure of keys as the Czech template. Keys missing in the file stay empty and are marked as missing.
Working with a translator: download the Czech JSON, have only the values (not the keys) translated, upload the file to the new language, check the missing texts and save.

After an update of the application new texts of the Czech version are added by themselves and texts you have not edited are updated. Texts edited here stay as they are. In other languages the new texts show as missing.

blocks.content: Uploading JSON replaces the texts of the language with the content of the file. Download a backup before uploading.

The Page titles tab sets the text in the browser tab and the headline in Google search results for every page of the website: Home page, Services, Projects, About us, Contact, FAQ, Help center, Careers (job list and job detail), the legal pages, Website maintenance and Page not found (404).

items: Choose the language with Language of the titles.
Edit the titles - the tab preview shows the result. Google shows roughly the first 60 characters.
Save page titles saves the changes, Discard changes reverts them.

blocks.content: Empty field = the Czech title is used. A good page title says what the page is about and the company name, for example “Services | Company Ltd.”.
Categories are shown on the FAQ page as tabs, the questions in their order. An answer is plain text - line breaks are kept.

items: Add category creates a category; fill in the Category name in all languages.
Add question adds a question and an answer to the category.
Move up / Move down change the order of categories and questions; Move to… moves a question to another category.
Remove question, or Remove the category with its questions.
Save stores everything at once; Discard changes returns the last saved state.

blocks.content: Positions are shown on the Careers page. The preview (title and short description) is in the list of positions, the type of employment, place and text blocks in the detail of the position, which also holds the application form.

steps.label: Add position
steps.text: Creates a new position (Hidden so far).

steps.label: Address (URL)
steps.text: Part of the address of the position detail, for example ui-designer. Only lower-case letters without diacritics, digits and hyphens; every position needs its own address. Changing it changes the link of the position.

steps.label: Preview in the list
steps.text: Title and Short description in every language.

steps.label: Detail of the position
steps.text: Type of employment, Place and any number of text blocks (Heading of the block + Text), for example What you will do, What we offer. Line breaks and bullets (•) are kept.

steps.label: Show on the website
steps.text: Ticking it publishes the position (status Shown). Unticking hides it without deleting.

steps.label: Save
steps.text: Saves all positions at once.

blocks.content: Change the order of positions with the arrows; Remove position deletes it (after saving). Applications from the form of a position are on the Job applicants page.
Projects are shown on the Projects page in the order of the editor. A row of the list shows the name, year and client, the detail the rest.

cards.title: Category
cards.text: For example Web development, Audit.

cards.title: Year / period and Client
cards.text: The same in all languages.

cards.title: Project
cards.text: Project name, Scope, Our role, Description and Result - in every language.

cards.title: Key features
cards.text: A list of features (Add feature / Remove feature).

cards.title: Technology stack
cards.text: Rows Layer (e.g. Frontend) + Technology (e.g. Angular).

cards.title: Image
cards.text: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 5 MB; on the website it is on the right next to the key features.

cards.title: Show on the website
cards.text: Publishes or hides the reference.

blocks.content: The image is saved right after uploading (independently of the Save button). For a new reference you upload it only after saving the reference.
The tab edits the public page Help center (/knowledge-base), where visitors learn what the system contains and how it works.

steps.label: Introduction of the page
steps.text: Main heading and the introduction text of the page.

steps.label: Blocks
steps.text: Below the introduction are the blocks in the order they appear on the website. Each has a Heading of the block and a Text of the block.

steps.label: Sub-blocks
steps.text: Optionally any number of sub-blocks (a smaller heading + text) - the Add sub-block button.

steps.label: Image at the end of the block
steps.text: One optional JPG, PNG or WebP image up to 5 MB. Videos or other files cannot be uploaded.

steps.label: Show on the website
steps.text: Hides or shows a block without deleting it.

steps.label: Save
steps.text: Saves the whole content at once.

items: Blocks and sub-blocks are added, moved with the arrows and removed.
The image is saved at once; the server shrinks it, converts it to WebP and strips its metadata (for example the location). A new block must be saved first, only then can an image be uploaded.
The text is plain - line breaks are kept.

sections.heading: 10. Languages and missing texts in the content tabs

blocks.content: The tabs FAQ, Jobs, References and Knowledge base have their own language switch. A language shows the number of missing translations and a missing field is highlighted with a warning that the website will show “Cannot load text”. An optional field empty in all languages is not shown on the website at all. The Unsaved changes mark warns of unsaved edits.

cards.title: Viewing
cards.text: web-edit-website-view - everything read-only.

cards.title: Editing
cards.text: web-edit-website-update - texts, languages, JSON, page titles, FAQ, jobs, references, knowledge base and images.

blocks.content: All changes are written to the web log.

On this page you manage the job applications applicants sent from the form of a job position on the website. By changing the status you tell colleagues how the hiring goes and in the internal note you record the results of interviews.

Applications contain personal data and CVs. Work with them only for hiring, do not share them outside the company and delete applications you no longer need. Without the applicant's consent to a longer record, applications are usually kept 6 months (Settings → Data retention).

On the detail of a job position the applicant fills in first name, last name, e-mail, phone, a cover message and attaches a CV (one file up to 20 MB - PDF, Word, ODT, Pages, RTF, TXT, an image or an archive). The application is saved with the status New applicant and the position applied for. Nothing is sent to the applicant automatically. The form is protected against robots; it does not work in the maintenance mode of the website.

cards.title: ID
cards.text: The number of the application.

cards.title: Applicant
cards.text: First and last name.

cards.title: Position
cards.text: The position applied for.

cards.title: Status
cards.text: New applicant, Invited to interview, Selected / Offer, Rejected, In pool (for the future).

cards.title: Received
cards.text: When the application arrived.

blocks.content: Filter by ID, last name, position name and status. The details (Details icon) show the full name, position, e-mail, phone, status, cover letter, internal HR note, the CV (View / Download) and the date received.

steps.label: Read the application
steps.text: The Details icon opens the cover letter and the CV.

steps.label: Status / Note
steps.text: The button in the row opens a form with two fields: Applicant status and Internal note.

steps.label: Applicant status
steps.text: Invited to interview → Selected / Offer or Rejected. Use In pool (for the future) only with the applicant's consent to a longer record.

steps.label: Internal note
steps.text: Interview result, impression, salary expectation … The applicant does not see it.

steps.label: Confirm
steps.text: The change is saved and written to the web log.

blocks.content: The data the applicant entered (name, contact, message, CV) cannot be changed. Answer the applicant from your own e-mail.

items: Delete moves an application to the trash; in the trash you restore it or delete it permanently together with the CV.
Applications can also be deleted in bulk (checkboxes → Delete selected).
New applications are shown in the calendar in the panel Waiting for you.
The export contains personal data - handle it with care.
